rows.behavior: action/prompts/ holds docs-vs-code.md, okf-vs-code.md and okf-vs-docs.md, and run --audit NAME sends that file's text as the user message for each of the three names.
rows.fails_when: a prompt file is missing or empty, or --audit NAME sends anything but that file's text

rows.behavior: run with no --audit, --prompt or --prompt-file sends okf-vs-code.md; --audit with --prompt or --prompt-file exits 2 naming both; an unknown --audit name exits 2; --help lists the three names.
rows.fails_when: the default is anything but okf-vs-code.md, a combination is accepted, an unknown name runs, or --help leaves out a name
rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_agent.py -k "default_prompt or audit_choices" -q

rows.behavior: action.yml's audit mode passes its audit input to --audit, and both its audit and publish modes use the report_name input (default agent-report) as the artifact name; .github/workflows/knowledge-audit.yml runs the audit and publish jobs as a matrix over docs-vs-code, okf-vs-code and okf-vs-docs with fail-fast off, each uploading and downloading its own agent-report-NAME artifact and publishing to its own issue title, publish running unless the run was cancelled, with the audit job still holding no token and no cache.
rows.fails_when: an audit is missing from either matrix, two audits share an artifact or an issue title, the action ignores report_name in either mode, one failed audit stops the other publishes, or the audit job gains a token or cache

rows.behavior: The how-to's section 5 names the three audits and the audit input, the tutorial points at --audit, ADR 0017 has a correction for the shipped audits, and the architecture overview shows the prompts.
rows.fails_when: a reader would still think the default audit checks only the .okf/ concepts that are due, or could not find how to pick an audit
